overall_reason: One UI sans (Segoe UI drawn at 1440, from a -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI" stack; system-ui at 375) sets every role, which fits a product component in Operate mode, so TYP-005 does not apply. The card head 'Recent deploys' (14px/600) and the row names (14px/500) differ only by one weight step at the same size, and two control labels sit at 12px in 500 and 550.

score.reason: T-LADDER fails on an unclear weight step between the card head and the row names (TYP-020); T-TYPE-SOURCE, T-LEADING and T-PUNCTUATION pass.

findings.title: Weight steps are clear
findings.where: card head span 'Recent deploys' against row names, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: The DOM shows 'Recent deploys' at 14px/600 and 'Checkout redesign', 'Search speedup' and 'Pricing copy' at 14px/500 (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png, top of the card). The 'Deploy' label is 12px/550 and the 'Ask AI' label is 12px/500.
findings.before: Card head 14px/600; row names 14px/500; control labels 12px at 550 and 500
findings.after: Separate the card head from the rows by size (a step of the fixed scale above 14px) or by a clear weight step (400 rows, 600 head); put both control labels on one weight
findings.why: A 500 to 600 step at the same size reads as a rendering accident, so the head does not stand above the list it names.

strengths: Timestamps ('Just now', '12m ago') sit at one size and weight, 12px/400, right-aligned.
